abstracts.content: In the 3 rd quarter of 2023, as in the previous two quarters, IRGKGD consumer confidence indicator increased, this time to - 17.9 p ts, which is 7.0 p ts higher than in the previous quarter and as much as 20.4 p ts higher than in the same period of the previous year. This is also the highest value of th e indicator in two years (in Q3 2021, the IRGKGD was - 16.6 points). At the same time, it is part of an ongoing trend of improving household sentiment s since the beginning of 2023, especially in comparison with the second half of 2022: in the first three quarters of 2023, the IRGKGD rose by a total of as many as 25.6 points. Moreover, in Q3 2023, as in the previous two periods, the values of all four com ponents of the index improved. Thus, at the moment, households no longer anticipate an economic downturn, and the reversal of the pessimistic trend of 2022 can be considered relatively permanent. The improvement in households' assess ments of their financial situation, observed throughout 2023, has been consistently accompanied over this period by an increase in optimism about the country's overall macroeconomic situation. The third quarter of 2023 was the third consecutive quarter in which responden ts' pessimism in assessing the prospects of the domestic labo r market decreased significantly. Over the period covered by the survey, the value of the balance of responses fell by as much as 10.4 points q - o - q, to 20.8 points, 17.7 points lower than a year earlier, 30.6 points lower than in Q4 2022 and the lowest sin ce Q1 2020 (then: 15.7 points). The third quarter of 2023 was also the third consecutive quarter in which the value of the balance of responses to the question on household inflation expectations fell significantly. At 26.7 points, it was therefore 6.7 poi nts lower than in the previous period and as much as 36.3 points lower than in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. This is also the lowest value of this balance since Q2 2018 (then: 24.8 points) and the second lowest since Q3 2016 (then: 25.1 points). This means that a significant improvement in households' sentiment regarding their inflation expectations in 2023 has become a fact, manifested, among other things, in the current value of the balance of responses being as much as 25.1 points lower than the long - term average

title: Stabilization Function of Public Finances: Implementation of Instruments in Conditions of Socio-Economic Crises

abstracts.content:
ABSTRACT: In the years 2020–2022, there was a significant slowdown in economic processes. The instability of macroeconomic factors necessitated efforts by public finance sector institutions to limit them. There were anti-crisis and stabilization measures that were supposed to lead to a return to the path of sustainable development. The aim of the paper is to identify the scope and possibilities of using stabilization instruments within the public finance sector and limiting the negative effects of crisis phenomena. As part of stabilization activities, targeted programs have already been launched, both on the scale of individual countries and internationally in the European Union, within the International Monetary Fund, and by other public entities. The scope of activities indicates an increased involvement of public resources in the social and economic spheres. Crisis phenomena indicate the advisability of using various stabilization instruments to reduce negative trends in the economy. The thematic scope of the study refers directly to current economic changes from a global perspective and also concerns selected national problems in Poland. It covers issues related to actions taken by public authorities to stabilize the economy in the face of changes caused by the above-mentioned crisis phenomena. Research indicates that the allocation of public resources to stabilize the economy may have other consequences, such as changing the structure of public expenditure to increase current expenditure, reducing the share of investment expenditure, and increasing the risk of excessive budget deficits and public debt, which may occur in the economy in the long term.
public finances, stabilizing the economy, public debt, budget deficit.

title: Determinants of Public Investment Effectiveness Evaluation in Unstable Macroeconomic Environment

abstracts.content: Investments in the public sector may be characterized by a lower sensitivity to macroeconomic changes, since their implementation is linked to the need to achieve certain social goals, so these investments are undertaken and implemented even in deteriorating economic conditions. However, this does not mean that the course of investment processes in the public sector is stable in a changing macroeconomic environment. The constrained investment financing capacity in public sector units is increasingly problematic. The purpose of the presented paper is to identify the changing conditions affecting the scope and approaches to measuring the effectiveness of investment projects in the public sector, not only in monetary terms, but also in social aspects. The research findings presented in the paper point to the role of current socio-economic factors in shaping decision-making processes, as well as to the principles and criteria for evaluating the impact of public spending in a situation of unstable economic development. The study presents an analysis of available methodologies and performance evaluation indicators, along with the potential for adapting or expanding the range of possible analytical and organizational solutions. The study also includes examples of changes in investment activity in the public sector at different levels of competence.

Rola regionalnych instytucji finansowych we wspieraniu rozwoju w Polsce

abstracts.content: Celem monografii pt. "Rola regionalnych instytucji finansowych we wspieraniu rozwoju w Polsce" było zbadanie aktualnej i możliwej roli regionalnych instytucji finansowych w polityce rozwoju regionalnego w Polsce. Wyniki analiz wykazały, że tworzenie instytucji finansowych (Regionalnych Funduszy Rozwoju - RFR) zajmujących się finansowaniem rozwoju regionalnego przynosi znaczące korzyści, głównie poprzez efektywne wykorzystanie ograniczonych środków, osiąganie korzyści skali w zarządzaniu finansami na poziomie województw, adaptację do nowych warunków finansowania, oraz wzmocnienie pozycji regionów w negocjacjach z innymi instytucjami finansowymi. Dodatkowo, RFR odgrywają kluczową rolę w zmniejszaniu luki finansowej dla małych i średnich przedsiębiorstw oraz wspieraniu inwestycji modernizacyjnych. Zaprezentowane w monografii studium przypadku Niemiec ukazało, jak rozwinięty system publicznych instytucji finansowych może przyczyniać się do rozwoju gospodarczego kraju. W Polsce, mimo że potencjał RFR nie dorównuje niemieckim regionalnym bankom rozwoju, istnieje znaczny potencjał dla rozwoju i integracji tych instytucji w regionalnych i krajowych rynkach finansowych. Analiza wykazała również pewne ograniczenia w stosowaniu instrumentów finansowych, takie jak ryzyko związane z niedoskonałym zarządzaniem i nadzorem korporacyjnym. Mimo to, korzyści płynące z RFR, jak mobilizacja środków z różnych źródeł czy akumulacja kapitału w regionach, są znaczące, zwłaszcza w kontekście zmniejszającej się pomocy bezzwrotnej z UE i potrzeby budowania odporności regionów. Podsumowując, monografia wskazuje na rosnącą rolę RFR w polityce rozwoju regionalnego w Polsce, podkreślając ich potencjał do promowania innowacji, wspierania przedsiębiorstw, oraz zwiększania efektywności wykorzystania środków finansowych. Praca podkreśla również, że adaptacja doświadczeń z innych krajów, takich jak Niemcy, może przyczynić się do dalszego rozwoju i skuteczności regionalnych instytucji finansowych w Polsce.

title: Monetary Transfer Provisions and the Rule of Law from the International Investment Law Perspective

abstracts.content: Monetary transfer provisions (MTP) are a standard feature of investment treaties. Despite their crucial importance for the realisation of foreign investment, and interpretation difficulties, they have not attracted much doctrinal attention to date. They are also rarely considered by investment tribunals. The extent of economic sanctions imposed on Russia in response to the 2022 aggression against Ukraine, and Russian retaliatory measures, foreclose most alternative opportunities for capital exporting. As a result, we may expect a wave of MTP claims against Russia, once the country rejoins the international community. The article summarizes the debate and makes suggestions for balancing public and private interests in this sensitive area for the economic rationality of investment and the financial basis of state survival. At the same time, it is a first step toward further research situating the issues of transfer clauses and monetary sovereignty in the broader context of public safety and the legality of economic sanctions.

Analiza różnic w wysokości emerytur kobiet i mężczyzn oraz ich konsekwencji dla systemu emerytalnego i społeczeństwa w Polsce

abstracts.content: Dotychczasowa debata na temat systemów emerytalnych w Polsce zdawała się często pomijać rolę kobiet i równości płci, mimo że wśród osób pobierających emeryturę w Polsce ponad 2/3 to kobiety [Ministerstwo Rodziny i Polityki Społecznej 2020]. Jest to szczególnie ważna kwestia ze względu na istnienie wyraźnej luki pomiędzy poziomem emerytur kobiet i mężczyzn. W istocie jest to dyskryminacja, która niesie za sobą negatywne skutki dla całego społeczeństwa. Pomimo istnienia aktów prawnych mających na celu walkę z dyskryminacją i zapewnienie równości obu płci, poziom emerytur kobiet i mężczyzn jest zróżnicowany. Celem tego opracowania jest wskazanie przyczyn oraz konsekwencji występowania luki emerytalnej w Polsce. Analiza opiera się na przeglądzie literatury oraz danych Zakładu Ubezpieczeń Społecznych.

title: Innovation as a factor of economic development. A comapartive analysis of economic theories of Joseph Schumpeter and Mariana Mazzucato

abstracts.content: The purpose of this article is to describe the foundations of economic theory on innovation using the work of Joseph A. Schumpeter and Mariana Mazzucato as examples. This characterization will support my later activities related to the implementation of my PhD dissertation, the main objective of which is to implement the "Policy for the Development of Artificial Intelligence in Poland from 2020" through modeling and implementation of program activities supporting the implementation of new technologies in the sector of smali and medium-sized enterprises (hereinafter: SMEs), including the involvement of key market players involved in such initiatives. The juxtaposition of the theories of these two economists is interesting insofar as it justifies the validity of active participation in the development and implementation of innovative Solutions, as well as the cooperation of the private and public sectors in this regard, which I have particularly highlighted when analyzing both economists

title: Wspólne kontrole w UE – nowe narzędzie transgranicznej współpracy organów podatkowych. Znaczenie dla cen transferowych

abstracts.content: W dniu 22.03.2021 r. Rada Unii Europejskiej uchwaliła dyrektywę 2021/514 zmieniającą dyrektywę 2011/16/UE w sprawie współpracy administracyjnej w dziedzinie opodatkowania  – dalej dyrektywa 2021/514. Jednym z obszarów problemowych podjętych przez dyrektywę 2021/514, który jest istotny dla obecnej praktyki transgranicznych kontroli podatkowych, jest wprowadzenie ram prawnych dla przeprowadzania tzw. wspólnych kontroli (joint audits) w ramach UE. Wspólne kontrole mają się istotnie przyczynić do rozwoju współpracy administracji podatkowych państw członkowskich UE, a w konsekwencji – do unikania transgranicznych sporów podatkowych, szczególnie z obszaru cen transferowych. W niniejszym artykule przedstawiono przyczyny wprowadzenia wspólnych kontroli do prawa Unii Europejskiej, omówiono założenia nowego narzędzia służącego do unikania sporów podatkowych, jak również przeanalizowano zastosowania wspólnych kontroli, w szczególności w cenach transferowych jako dziedzinie podatków międzynarodowych.

title: The EU’s development assistance: between shared vision and divergent interests

abstracts.content: The article seeks to show the dynamics of the relationship between the two dimensions of European development aid policy. The purpose is to explore the possibility of creating a true collective EU development assistance understood as coherent and harmonized EU actions towards third countries. The article is based on a synthetic summary and interpretation of available data on latest trends in development assistance and a review of the subject literature. It allowed to demonstrate the relevance of the studied issue in the context of recent changes, especially caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. To this end, firstly, the rules, institutional and treaty framework of the EU development assistance were explained, secondly, the changes that occurred in EU development policy also as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic were indicated, and thirdly, the real contribution of EU institutions and member states in development cooperation was shown.

title: The EU’s Development Policy

abstracts.content:
The EU is the world’s largest donor of development aid, responsible for
providing about half of the global development assistance. The unique position of the EU in
the international development system is that it is both a bilateral donor, providing aid
directly to developing countries, and a multilateral organisation, coordinating the national
aid policies of its Member States. This is due to the structure of the EU’s specific area of
multi-level interaction, the so-called shared competencies between Member States and EU
institutions. Thus, the planning and implementation of the EU’s external action is the result
of two processes: first, arrangements at the Member-States level, and second, joint decisions
at the level of Community institutions. The EU member countries of Central and Eastern
Europe (CEE) play a rather similar yet limited role in EU development policy. This is due to
two factors: (1) similar aid delivery focused on multilateral channels and the concentration
of aid on countries in the nearest neighbourhood, and (2) a relatively low commitment of
both financial and human resources. This distinguishes them sharply from Western
European countries and puts them in the position of catch-up countries in the field of
international development assistance. The article outlines the main areas of involvement of
CEE member states in development assistance. It addresses two basic problems: first, the
issue of building a community-based and coherent EU development policy, and second, the
gap in engagement between Western EU Member States and Eastern countries. Thus, based
on a comparative method, an attempt was made to show their performance against other
EU Member States, as well as to explain their relatively low involvement in international
development assistance. Reference is also made to the humanitarian and refugee crisis in
Ukraine, showing its most important activities related to large-scale humanitarian
assistance. The paper is based on a synthetic summary and interpretation of available data
on the latest trends in development assistance and a review of the subject literature. It
allowed to demonstrate the relevance of the studied issue in the context of recent changes,
especially caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. To this end, firstly, the rules, institutional
and treaty framework of the EU development assistance were explained, secondly, the
changes that occurred in EU development policy in 2018–2021 and thirdly, the real
contribution of EU institutions and Member States in development cooperation was show.

Gra o obszary zdegradowane : ekonomiczny wymiar polityki rewitalizacji

abstracts.content:
W pierwszym rozdziale, wychodząc od nieefektywności wykorzystania czynników wytwórczych w obszarach zdegradowanych, wyodrębniłam uniwersalne cechy tych obszarów, wyjaśniając dlaczego negatywne zjawiska koncentrują się w konkretnych miejscach w miejskiej przestrzeni. Obok wyjaśnień mechanizmów zakłócających równowagę na rynku nieruchomości i rynku pracy osadzonych w teorii ekonomii, przywołałam także eksplanacyjną rolę koncepcji kapitału kulturowego P. Bourdieu, teorii wielopoziomowej selekcji R.C. Weavera oraz pojęcia społecznej praktyki interpretacyjnej G. Abla. To interdyscyplinarne podejście pozwoliło już w początkowej części monografii rozwinąć dotychczas dominujące w literaturze podejście do analiz czynników degradacji z perspektywy pojedynczych dyscyplin naukowych.
W drugim rozdziale głównym celem było poszukiwanie uniwersalnych prawidłowości procesów rewitalizacji poprzez pogłębioną analizę prawie dwustuletniej historii polityki wobec obszarów zdegradowanych w różnych krajach, w szczególności w Wielkiej Brytanii i Stanach Zjednoczonych, a także w Holandii, Francji, Szwecji, Danii. Nowatorskim podejściem w tej części monografii było zastosowanie koncepcji naukowych programów badawczych (zbiorów teorii) Imre Lakatosa jako ramy do analizy polityk rewitalizacyjnych, traktowanych jako kompleksowy system założeń i heurystyk. W tym kontekście przedstawiłam przegląd i analizę tych polityk jako złożonych systemów założeń oraz stosowanych w nich instrumentów w trzech wyróżnionych etapach: programów masowych wyburzeń (slum clearance), programów wsparcia odnowy zdegradowanych dzielnic (urban renewal) i najbardziej współczesnej w obszarach zdegradowanych wieloaspektowej interwencji (urban revitalisation). Na podstawie tego przeglądu zweryfikowałam drugą hipotezę, że od XIX wieku do dnia dzisiejszego zachodziła ewolucja polityk publicznych wobec obszarów zdegradowanych (polityk rewitalizacyjnych) w ramach jednego paradygmatu, to jest systemu opartego na kilku niezmiennych podstawowych założeniach (tzw. trzonu), a zmiany polegały na jego uszczegóławianiu i uzupełnianiu, a nie przejściu do konkurencyjnego systemu (podejścia). 
W trzecim rozdziale monografii, uwzględniając kontekst dwóch zuniwersalizowanych filarów, tj. cech obszarów zdegradowanych i prawidłowości regulujących proces rewitalizacji, przeprowadziłam kluczową dla osiągnięcia głównego celu pracy analizę. Sięgnęłam do teorii gier w celu uchwycenia zależności między działaniami różnych interesariuszy prywatnych i publicznych w obszarach zdegradowanych. Pozwoliło to wyjaśnić podejmowane przez interesariuszy decyzje i ocenić efekty ich działań z punktu widzenia wpływu na wychodzenie obszarów rewitalizowanych z degradacji w kategoriach atrybutów gry przeciwko naturze, gry o sumie zerowej oraz gry kooperacyjnej. Podejście to zastosowałam do wyjaśnienia relacji między podmiotami sektora prywatnego oraz władzy publicznej w przykładach teoretycznych i celowo dobranych studiach przypadku miast Cleveland i Stockton w USA, Montrealu w Kanadzie, Kingston na Jamajce i Tybingi w Niemczech, reprezentujących różne typowe sytuacje występujące w obszarach rewitalizacji. Zastosowanie teorii gier jako ramy do wyjaśnienia procesu rewitalizacji jest oryginalnym rozwiązaniem naukowym, które może ułatwić przyszłe badania tego procesu.
Nowością jest także wykorzystanie przedstawionej w rozdziale trzecim ramy analitycznej opartej na teorii gier do przeglądu i oceny różnych polityk publicznych wobec obszarów zdegradowanych, a następnie do określenia warunków brzegowych ich skutecznego stosowania w sposób ograniczający niepewność i rywalizację o środki finansowe oraz kształtujący warunki do synergicznych działań inwestorów. Poświęciłam temu czwarty rozdział monografii. Każdy z analizowanych typów instrumentów przeanalizowałam w monografii, oceniając warunki zastosowania poszczególnych instrumentów dla wyjścia z gry przeciw naturze, stymulacji gry o sumie niezerowej, mechanizmu zabezpieczającego przed grą o sumie zerowej oraz tworzenia warunków do superaddytywnej gry kooperacyjnej. Instrumentami podlegającymi ocenie były zarówno zachęty takie jak ulgi i zwolnienia podatkowe, granty (dotacje) i instrumenty zwrotne (niskooprocentowane pożyczki), inwestycje władz publicznych, subwencje dla prywatnych inwestorów, w tym finansowane opodatkowaniem przyrostowym, jak i instrumenty przymusu, takie jak nakaz dostosowania budynków mieszkalnych do standardów prawa budowlanego, przymusowy wykup lub wywłaszczenie nieruchomości, oraz przymusowy najem lokali użytkowych przy głównych ulicach. Obok znaczenia teoretycznego tej części monografii, istotny jest także jej walor aplikacyjny przy modyfikacjach polityki wobec obszarów zdegradowanych. Przeprowadzona analiza ma uniwersalny charakter, dzięki czemu sprawdzi się, niezależnie od krajowych uwarunkowań. W celu sprawdzenia możliwości jej praktycznego zastosowania przeprowadzono w rozdziale piątym ocenę założeń stosowania zachęt i instrumentów przymusowych w obszarach rewitalizacji w Polsce, skali ich dotychczasowego praktycznego wykorzystania oraz określiłam warunki brzegowe skuteczności ich stosowania w kategoriach teorii gier. Dzięki zrealizowanemu badaniu udało się osiągnąć cel sformułowany we wprowadzeniu, tworząc – jedną z możliwych – syntetyczną ramy teoretycznej do oceny instrumentów polityki rewitalizacyjnej niezależnie od jej bieżącego czy długoterminowego wymiaru oraz krajowych uwarunkowań, której od dawna brakowało w europejskiej literaturze przedmiotu.

abstracts.content: Social Aspects of Ageing - Selected Challenges, Analyses, and Solutions, focuses on the key challenges underlined by the United Nations during the Decade of Healthy Ageing (2021-2030). The authors introduce studies in areas crucial for older people, their families, and communities, such as combatting ageism, age-friendly environments, and care provision. The volume also examines issues linked to the global, national, regional, and local implementation of age-specific and intergenerational solutions, initiatives, and programs towards achieving the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). The collection contains chapters representing research and practical recommendations from various disciplines, such as critical studies, geographical gerontology, legal studies, public health, and sociology. This volume is an asset to academic and professional communities interested in theories of ageing as well as public services and ageing policies. In addition, the book aims to help students, practitioners, and people working in government, business, and nonprofit organizations.

title: Climate Risk: Reshaping the Energy Sector

abstracts.content:
Objective: Climate risk is one of the major challenges for the energy sector globally. The energy transition and the struggle against climate change are putting increasing pressure on energy entities as well as create a need for action to mitigate climate risks. The purpose of this article is to characterise climate risk in the energy sector, with a focus on the electric power sector, as well as to review their impact on the functioning of energy entities.
 Research Design & Methods: This article reviews the literature and uses publicly available data on the operation of the electricity system and the price of CO2 emission allowances in the EU ETS so as to characterise the impact of climate risk on the energy sector with a particular focus on the Polish electricity sector.
 Findings: Climate risk is one of the most important risks determining the functioning of entities in the energy sector and affecting the energy transition. It manifests itself in the form of the emergence of a set of new risks: carbon risk, weather risk, financial risk, regulatory risk, and social risk, all of which directly affect energy operators and reshape the energy sector.
 Implications/Recommendations: The above creates the need to adapt and adjust to current market trends as well as the need to mitigate climate risks in order to keep a market position. It is, therefore, necessary to implement climate risk management measures to adapt the company’s operations to changing market realities and an increasing exposure to climate risk. The results of the study can be used by policymakers and decision-makers responsible for energy policy and companies’ strategy related to energy transition and compliance with the ESG standards.
 Contribution/Value added: The research contributes to the field of climate risk in the energy sector. The value added of the paper is the interdisciplinary approach to a broad concept of climate risk, consisting both of transition and physical risks, with a detailed analysis about its influence on the energy sector

Change - The transformative power of citizen science

abstracts.content: We are in a time of rapid change on multiple levels. Change can be seen as positive by one group and negative by another. As a result, different perspectives on any given change can draw completely different conclusions. In these proceedings we want to address different approaches to change from all kinds of perspectives within the realm of citizen science and participatory research. We discuss both active, transformative change, and the observation of change monitored by citizen science in all kinds of disciplines. We highlight the potential of citizen science to be a change maker in research and society, and as a tool to manage the change happening around us. The proceedings "Change - The transformative power of citizen science" showcase a selection of topics that have been presented and discussed at the ECSA/ACSC 2024 double conference in Vienna and highlight the transformative power, citizen science can have.

title: Proceedings of the 23rd International Conference on Group Decision and Negotiation

abstracts.content:
We are considering a group decision makers (DMs) operating independent logistic fleets who are competing for the same resources. The logistic fleets under consideration share a common transportation network infrastructure that has a limited capacity such as maximum throughput, or freight terminal capacity. Since the throughput is limited, decisions of fleet operators have external effects and are affecting the decision situation of all other actors. Examples of such systems include transportation a vast amount of goods over a shared rail network or operators servicing different competing marine cargo ports. Since the DMs share a common limited transportation infrastructure they can either decide to negotiate a cooperation or make decisions independently which can lead to an inefficient Nash equilibrium.
The goal of this research is to identify the optimal actions that can be taken by them in orders to mitigate costs. This has been achieved by formulating a mathematical programming problem and conducting a set of numerical experiments.

title: Characteristics and Expectations of Low-Paid Workers in the Care Services Sector in Poland

abstracts.content: The article analyses the specific nature of work among elderly caregivers in Poland as a low-paid group and identifies these employees’ expectations towards employers. In the context of an aging society, which increases the demand for caregiving services, the low level of compensation and social prestige associated with this profes-sion poses a significant challenge that may negatively impact employ-ees’ engagement and job satisfaction. The study is based on literature review, a survey method directed at caregiving sector employees and statistical data analysis, which enabled a comprehensive identification of factors affecting their motivation and expectations. The results indi-cate the need to implement motivational strategies aimed at improving working conditions and enhancing job satisfaction among caregivers. Applying such solutions may contribute to increased productivity and reduced employee turnover in this professional group.

title: Technological innovation as a basis for a paradigm shift in insurance: The search for new sharing economy effects

abstracts.content:
Innovation in the financial markets sector is an ongoing race between companies. In relation to the insurance market, these effects include the use of new technologies in the preparation of products, building more efficient processes, shaping a new image of the organisation or building new marketing messages. The purpose of this chapter is to demonstrate the possibility of re-constructing the concept of a community of risk. New technological devices allow us to determine the probability of particular events accurately. As a consequence of the use of new technologies, we reduce the level of information asymmetry between the insured and the insurer. We can accurately determine the future size of the loss. Therefore, in the long term, there is no need to build up large stocks of capital because the accumulated contribution makes it possible to precisely cover the consequences of events in this community of risk. The economics of the future must seek innovative solutions with a view to future generations, referring also to the past. Properly constructed methods of acceptance and price determination will make it possible to return once again to the original idea of mutual insurance, in which a group of people can trust each other and are ready to cover their losses together.

In detail, the analysis will be supported by calculations of the agricultural drought risk in Poland and indication factors of using the satellite images and the electronic measurements of yields. It may allow for a more precise determination of actual losses and correct calculation of insurance premiums.

abstracts.content: Refugees’ inclusion into education and the labour market, the two crucial areas of integration, is not free from challenges, which are very often related to an unsuitable structure or limited state capacity, or both. In Catalonia, the most serious issues were a lack of coordination between different levels of integration governance, namely between the state administration, regional and local authorities, and the limited capacity of local municipalities on the frontline in providing educational opportunities to refugee youth. The structural and capacity-related challenges were further detailed in the chapters related to refugees’ integration into the labour market. Female refugees appeared to be a vulnerable group in the Swedish labour market due to their disadvantaged position and lack of sufficient support comparable to male counterparts. The Swedish integration programme, although not free from drawbacks, was used to gain some knowledge about how to look for and apply for a job in Sweden.

title: Marketing treści w organizacji pozarządowej

abstracts.content: Celem artykułu jest przedstawienie marketingu treści jako ważnego narzędzia komunikacji, budowania marki i zaangażowania odbiorców nie tylko w praktyce biznesowej, lecz także w działaniach organizacji pozarządowych. Autor zarysowuje koncepcję marketingu treści, wskazując jednocześnie na różnorodne możliwości jej zastosowania w praktyce. Na przykładzie National Geographic pokazuje, jak marketing treści może być wdrożony w niedochodowej organizacji. Zwraca uwagę na kluczowe kwestie użyteczności i atrakcyjności treści, w tym takie czynniki jak różnorodność form i kanałów dystrybucji treści oraz ich dostosowanie do potrzeb i oczekiwań odbiorców. Wskazuje także na korzyści, które może osiągnąć organizacja dzięki dobrze prowadzonym działaniom marketingu treści: zwiększenie świadomości marki, zbudowanie pozytywnego wizerunku, przyciągnięcie i utrzymanie różnorodnych grup odbiorców czy zwiększenie zainteresowania misją danego podmiotu.

Die Verringerung der Mehrwertsteuerlücke in den Jahren 2016-2022: Polnische Erfahrungen. Ursachen – Maßnahmen – Zukunftsperspektiven

abstracts.content: Diese Ausgabe ist die deutschsprachige Übersetzung des Originals: Ograniczenie luki VAT w Polsce w latach 2016-2022. Przyczyny – środki – dalsze perspektywy von Jan Sarnowski und Paweł Selera.  Die Monographie analysiert Rechtsakte der EU und des nationalen Rechts und zitiert auch ausländische Rechtsquellen - ausgewählte interne Regelungen der EU-Länder. Die Autoren stützen ihre Überlegungen auf Daten und Berichte internationaler Organisationen, einschließlich der OECD und der Europäischen Kommission. Sie verwenden auch Daten aus inländischen Quellen, darunter Berichte des RH-PL, des Finanzministeriums und einer Reihe von Industrie- und Wirtschaftsorganisationen. Die Autoren sehen die Aufgabe dieser Veröffentlichung darin, einen umfassenden Überblick über die von den polnischen Behörden zwischen 2016 und 2022 ergriffenen Maßnahmen zur Verringerung der Mehrwertsteuerlücke zu geben. Im Verlauf der Argumentation stellen die Autoren die Hauptkomponenten der Mehrwertsteuerlücke und die Instrumente zu deren Verringerung vor und beschreiben deren erwartete oder beobachtete Wirkung bei der Reduzierung der unerwünschten Phänomene. Andere Auswirkungen der implementierten Lösungen bleiben außerhalb des Rahmens dieser Analyse, insbesondere die Fragen des Eingriffs der Behörden in die Sphäre der Bürgerrechte oder die bei den Unternehmern entstehenden Anpassungskosten Im ersten Teil der Monographie werden die Gründe für die erhebliche Vergrößerung der Mehrwertsteuerlücke im ersten Jahrzehnt des 21. Jahrhunderts dargestellt. Es werden die Merkmale der EU-Mehrwertsteuervorschriften, die sie besonders anfällig für die Aktivitäten der organisierten Kriminalität machen, sowie die von der „Mehrwertsteuer-Mafia“ begangenen Straftaten, die diese Schwächen ausnutzen, vorgestellt.Darüber hinaus werden Daten über das Ausmaß der Mehrwertsteuerlücke in den EU-Ländern und den Anteil der Steuerkriminalität an dieser Lücke vorgestellt. Im zweiten Teil der Monographie werden Maßnahmen zur Schließung der Mehrwertsteuerlücke vorgestellt, die auf supranationaler Ebene von den Behörden der Europäischen Union und auf nationaler Ebene von einzelnen Mitgliedstaaten ergriffen wurden. In diesem Teil werden auch die Richtungen für die weitere Verbesserung der Mehrwertsteuergesetzgebung skizziert, die derzeit diskutierten Vorschläge der Europäischen Kommission und die Forderungen der Steuerwissenschaft an die EU und die nationalen Entscheidungsträger vorgestellt. Der dritte Teil der Monografie befasst sich mit den Maßnahmen, die Polen zwischen 2016 und 2022 zur Schließung der Mehrwertsteuerlücke ergriffen hat. Das erste Kapitel dieses Teils der Arbeit ist eine Analyse des „Ausgangspunkts“ der genannten Aktivitäten, d. h. der Art der in Polen beobachteten Unregelmäßigkeiten und der in den Jahren 2010-2015 unternommenen ersten Versuche zur Beschränkung der Mehrwertsteuerlücke.

Analysing Web Traffic: A Case Study on Artificial and Genuine Advertisement-Related Behaviou

abstracts.content:
This book presents ample, richly illustrated account on results and experience from a project, dealing with the analysis of data concerning behavior patterns on the Web. The advertising on the Web is dealt with, and the ultimate issue is to assess the share of the artificial, automated activity (ads fraud), as opposed to the genuine human activity.

After a comprehensive introductory part, a full-fledged report is provided from a wide range of analytic and design efforts, oriented at: the representation of the Web behavior patterns, formation and selection of telling variables, structuring of the populations of behavior patterns, including the use of clustering, classification of these patterns, and devising most effective and efficient techniques to separate the artificial from the genuine traffic.

A series of important and useful conclusions is drawn, concerning both the nature of the observed phenomenon, and hence the characteristics of the respective datasets, and the appropriateness of the methodological approaches tried out and devised. Some of these observations and conclusions, both related to data and to methods employed, provide a new insight and are sometimes surprising.

The book provides also a rich bibliography on the main problem approached and on the various methodologies tried out.

title: Economics of energy security: perspectives of natural gas exporters

abstracts.content: There has been a burgeoning interest in energy security in recent years due to the transformation of the energy landscape through deepening market deregulation, rising environmental challenges, growing energy hunger, and significant political changes. Depicting energy security as an evolving concept that absorbs economic and political conditions, this book adopts an economic approach to energy security in the international gas market. Uniquely, the book explores the theoretical assumptions and practical consequences attached to both demand and supply-side security in global energy markets. It investigates why energy exporters are so protective of independence in energy exports. The book also looks at the critically important issue of environmental aspects of energy security, particularly around climate change. It also analyses the potential for a cartel in the international gas market, similarly to the oil industry. This book will be of much interest to readers in energy economics, energy security, energy policy, IR/security studies, and relevant policy-makers.

title: Research on immersive interactive experience of content e-commerce live users in the era of computer digital marketing

abstracts.content: Several challenges lie in traditional video technology due to consumer’s pursuit of high-definition demand and virtual immersive interactive environment are being used in computer digital marketing domain. For smart city planning, in order to provide immersive interactive experience for users of content ecommerce live broadcast, panoramic video transmission scheme based on Simple Mail Transfer (SMT) protocol is designed. It uses advantages of intelligent media transmission protocol media content self-organization and heterogeneous network compatibility. In this scheme, server transmits high-quality block video via two-way Internet, and transmits low quality complete panoramic video via one-way broadcast network. Such transmission scheme can use heterogeneous network resources to share overall traffic pressure of Internet. The realization of this scheme is accomplished by improving signaling system of SMT protocol for client-driven panoramic video dynamic streaming transmission. Heterogeneous network synchronization problem is solved utilizing the proposed scheme by exploring characteristics of SMT protocol.

title: Income and well-being in old age:  The role of local contextual factors

abstracts.content: While the role of local contextual factors as determinants of well-being has been broadly acknowledged, the literature has focused primarily on identification of individual level determinants. Using a unique dataset linking regional and individual-level information we investigate the association of well-being and local conditions among a sample of Polish individuals aged 50 and over. The results confirm high correlation of well-being with income, and we show that this correlation grows with the quality of local conditions. Similarly, a change in the composite measure of the latter is positively associated with well-being only for high income respondents. The findings highlight a particular set of policy challenges from the point of view of old age poverty and area-based social exclusion. They offer support for targeted financial transfers, and call for improvements in local conditions, in particular in accessibility to public services for low-income older individuals.

title: Media management: The attention perspective

abstracts.content: Ponieważ media są jednym z pierwszych sektorów gospodarki informacyjnej, które zostały w pełni zdigitalizowane (tj. w zakresie projektowania, produkcji, dystrybucji i konsumpcji), era zarządzania nimi dobiegła końca. Istniejące granice między różnymi rodzajami mediów załamały się, podobnie jak wszelkie ograniczenia dotyczące czasu i przestrzeni rozpowszechniania się mediów. Jednak ta pozornie nieograniczona ekspansja rynków medialnych i nadmiar mediów napotkały nową barierę, jaką jest uwaga ludzi/konsumentów potrzebna do konsumpcji mediów. Biorąc pod uwagę skracające się okresy uwagi (co udokumentowano w badaniach empirycznych), uwaga jest coraz częściej postrzegana jako najcenniejszy zasób dla sektora medialnego i należy opracować i zarządzać nowymi strategiami przyciągania, zatrzymywania i podtrzymywania uwagi. Zarządzanie uwagą staje się teraz nowym rdzeniem zarządzania mediami.

With media being one of the first sectors of the information economy to be fully (i.e., with respect to its design,  production, distribution and consumption) digitized, an era of its management has come to an end.  Existing boundaries between different media types have collapsed, as well as all limitations about time and space of media dissemination.  However, this seemingly limitless expansion of media markets and media overabundance has come across a new barrier, which is that of human/consumers’ attention needed for media consumption.  Given shortening attention spans (as documented by empirical research), attention is increasingly perceived as the most valuable resource for the media sector and new strategies for attracting, retaining and sustaining attention must be devised and managed.  Managing attention is now becoming the new core of media management.

title: Conceptualization and Measuring the Digital Economy

abstracts.content: With the rapid development of digital technology, a wide range of academic fields is devoting an increasing amount of attention to the study of “digital citizen building”, often known as “DC”. Despite the widespread use of the word, academics are free to define DC in any way they think proper. The primary emphasis of this extensive inquiry is an in-depth examination of every book that has ever been written about DC themes and values. Journal articles that other researchers have evaluated made up 114 of the total. The topic of education is mentioned in more than half of the entries on the list. Even while each major DC notion was welcomed by its specific disc method, they all had one thing in common: a storm. Concerns raised by participants and prior research on the DC study were considered in these outcomes. The difficulty is that there is a significant shortage of research information on young children, as well as a deficiency in the use of conventional methods of research that are relevant to developmental cohesion. According to the findings of the current integrated study, collaboration across different racial groups is necessary to solve both policy and operational challenges in the District of Columbia research community.

title: The Comparative Analysis Dedicated to the Ambitions of Commercial Banks: Traditional Banking Models Vs. Fintechs Solutions

abstracts.content: This research is dedicated to ambitions of commercial banks in a form of a comparison of existing traditional banking models Versus FinTech solutions. Examples presented in the study are based on global market and forecasts are based on McKinsey and CB Insights reports. The hypothesis of this research imposed and suggested there are neither traditional model of commercial banks will remain at the constant, instead due to the mutual gain of the symbiosis the symbiosis commercial banks and FinTechs will respond to incentives. Research questions were: i) what are the ambitions of commercial banks in generating profits and how do they change in line with growth of the market of FinTechs? ii) to which extent traditional banking models and FinTechs solutions can be compared by assessed form the perspective of operations?; iii) which scenario out of tradition banking models, FinTechs only and a symbiosis between both is most likely to progress in the closest decade? Findings demonstrate that commercial banks’ financial ambitions continue to transform in line with product diversification they propose, commercial banks transform in their products and pricing will keep in balance between remaining competitive and profitable. The most realistic scenario in the future of commercial banks and FinTech solutions is the in-depth symbiosis.

title: Volatility of the USD/CHF exchange rate at the beginning of the COVID-19 pandemic

abstracts.content:
Purpose
We address the problem of forecasting USD/CHF volatility at the beginning of the COVID-19 crisis. We chose popular currencies (Swiss franc and American dollar) in the period 1.07.2020 to 31.12.2020.
Design/methodology/approach
We employed several volatility models, including APARCH, EGARCH, GJR-GARCH, TGARCH, and GARCH-MIDAS, on high-frequency USD/CHF data. Particular emphasis was placed on asymmetric models to capture volatility asymmetry.
Findings
The highest volatility occurred during the first wave of the COVID-19 pandemic. Volatility forecasts are most accurate with EGARCH and GARCH-MIDAS models that incorporate long-term asymmetry, particularly when predicting volatility over a longer planning horizon. GARCH-MIDAS models with short-term asymmetry perform best in the sample but are inferior in forecasting future volatility (out-of-sample).
Originality
The originality refers to the subject of study (exchange rates instead of stocks), the methods used (GARCH-MIDAS, asymmetric volatility models), and the particular crisis period (the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic).
Research limitations/implications
Even in a market of relatively low volatility, such as forex, volatility reveals both long- and short-run components during the pandemic crisis and some asymmetry. Therefore, the use of more complicated methods is sometimes not justified by the improvement of prediction accuracy. The results are limited to specific data and a crisis period. Therefore, in the future, we need to determine whether these methods are effective in periods with average volatility.

title: Reakcje rynku na zmiany składów indeksów ESG

otherTitles.title: Market Reactions to ESG Index Reconstitution

abstracts.content:
Cel | Celem artykułu jest rozpoznanie problematyki reakcji inwestorów na zmiany składu indeksów ESG w kontekście wyników dotychczasowych badań.
Metoda badań | Wykorzystana metoda badawcza to krytyczny przegląd literatury.
Wnioski | Wyniki zdecydowanej większości dotychczasowych badań dowodzą, że inwestorzy reagują na sygnał w postaci włączenia spółki do indeksu ESG lub wykluczenia jej z niego. Wyniki te jednak bardzo różnią się pod względem charakteru obserwowanej reakcji. Wiele wskazuje na to, że reakcja inwestorów może mieć charakter kontekstowy i ulegać modyfikacjom w zależności od układu innych czynników, takich jak warunki otoczenia czy cechy spółek.
Oryginalność / wartość / implikacje / rekomendacje | Zrozumienie mechanizmów reakcji inwestorów na zmiany składu indeksów ESG jest ważne zarówno z punktu widzenia funkcjonowania rynku, jak i samych spółek. W przypadku tych ostatnich pozwoli bardziej świadomie podejmować decyzje o zmianie polityki ESG skutkującej włączeniem spółki do indeksu lub wykluczeniem jej z niego oraz dokonywać wyboru indeksów, w których spółka chce być obecna.

Purpose | The purpose of the article is to explore the subject of investor reactions to changes in the composition of ESG indices based on the results of previous research.
Research method | The used research method is a critical review of the literature.
Results | The results of the most studies to date show that investors react to a signal in the form of a company’s inclusion in or exclusion from an ESG index. However, the results widely vary in terms of the nature of this reaction. And there is much to indicate that this reaction may be contextual and modifying, depending on the pattern of other
factors such as environmental conditions or company characteristics.
Originality / value / implications / recommendations | Understanding the mechanisms of investor reaction to ESG indices reconstitution is important both for market functioning and for the companies themselves. In the case of the latter, it will allow more informed decisions to change ESG policies resulting in a company’s inclusion or exclusion from an index, and to make choices about the indices in which a company wants to be present.

title: Management of restrictions during the SARS-Cov-2 pandemic in Central European countries

abstracts.content: The SARS-COV-2 pandemic, which affected many countries, including the countries of Central Europe, caused many changes in the functioning of society to date. These changes concerned numerous limitations of human rights and freedoms that were imposed by public authorities on individuals in countries affected by the pandemic. The fight against the pandemic has confronted the governments, as well as the societies living in them, with previously unknown challenges. For in no country in Central Europe has there been any special pandemic legislation that would uniformly regulate the powers of the state in situations of similar disasters. However, in order to effectively control the threats associated with the epidemic, an international exchange of experiences and new normative solutions in the realities of the current crisis situation become necessary. The fight against the epidemic, although it is associated with severe restrictions and limitations on the rights and freedoms of each individual, must be properly perceived by society as a society-wide effort requiring sacrifice, the success of which requires joint and coordinated cooperation of all entities.

title: International orientation of key decision-makers and firm internationalization: evidence from small and medium-sized companies in Poland

abstracts.content:
With  the  global  integration  of  economic  environments and progressing digitalization, internationalization of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) is becoming one of the drivers of economic growth. Thus, identification of determinants of SMEs internationalization, which involves considering multiple factors at different levels, constitutes an important research area. While environmental-level and firm-level characteristics have been broadly studied as drivers of SME internationalization, less attention was given to individual-level determinants.  
Therefore, the research problem of this monograph is the influence of individual-level determinants such as manager’s international characteristics and international orientation on SMEs international performance. International orientation (IO) in this doctoral thesis is defined as an individual-level characteristic pertaining to SME decision-maker. Internationally orientated managers are viewed as those who have an international vision for their company and are fully committed to deepening the presence on existing foreign markets and to exploring opportunities in new countries. It is assumed that internationally oriented managers have a greater ability to collect and interpret crucial information about foreign environments and use it to strengthen firm’s degree of internationalization. In addition, they also perceive higher benefits from internationalization. This topic was chosen due to the research gap identified: there is limited number of quantitative studies that investigate the interrelations between individual-level determinants of SME internationalization such as managerial characteristics and orientations especially in Polish and other CEE transition economies context. In relation to the research gap and Resource-Based View as well as Upper Echelons theory and International Entrepreneurship models, the main objective of this book was thus the investigation of manager’s international characteristics determining SME decision-maker’s international orientation, and the influence of SME decision-maker’s international orientation on firm internationalization measured with both subjective and objective variables. This book adopts an empirical-theoretical approach. The basis for the theoretical elaborations constitutes the review of foreign and Polish literature on international decision-maker characteristics and decision-maker international orientation impacting the firm internationalization processes. The primary research was performed by means of a survey administered via CATI (Computer Assisted Telephone Interviews) method by a professional research agency in the period of November-December 2014. The study had a nationwide coverage, the responding companies were sourced proportionally from all provinces (voivodships) in Poland. The final research population was composed of 302 Polish internationalized (outward internationalization) small and medium-sized enterprises operating in manufacturing sector, employing 10-249 employees (micro-enterprises were not included). The respondents were recruited among the key SME decision-makers: Chief Executive Officers (CEOs), general-managers and members of the management board. Approximately one third of the respondents were at the same time the owner or co-owner of the company they represented. It is assumed that Polish context is representative of European transition economies and that the research results may be applicable in this setting. Quantitative data analysis method: Partial Least Squares - Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) was applied. Statistical analysis was conducted utilizing SmartPLS 3 program. Based on empirical verification performed on 302 Polish SMEs, it can be concluded that among the investigated managerial international characteristics only international experiences gathered in the course of professional career including work experience in international setting (having worked in an export/import department of a national company, having worked in multinational teams on a daily basis and having worked in an MNE with daily contact with foreigners) and business travel abroad (on condition that it was frequent and the manager liked it) constitute important manager’s features, which positively influence the formation of decision-maker’s IO. On the other hand, decision-maker’s international exposure in private life during childhood and education, according to the results of this doctoral research, does not influence manager’s international orientation in Polish SME context. The only exception being young managers (aged 30-45) whose international education does positively impact their IO. In addition, proficiency in foreign languages (in English, German and Russian) proved irrelevant for the formation of SME decision-maker international orientation in the general sample. However, it was observed that in SMEs with extensive international experience manager’s good command of German language may be detrimental to decision-maker’s IO due to limiting his international vision. To conclude, the study highlights that international orientation in general population of Polish SME decision-makers is formed mainly by manager’s experiences gathered in professional life, while for young managers (aged 30-45) also international education brings an additional positive impact on their international orientation. Further, this study reveals that international orientation of SME decision-maker positively influences both firm internationalization degree and perceived internationalization benefits. This finding confirms the importance of the international orientation of managers during the SMEs internationalization process in Poland and CEE countries.

title: The Chain of Emergencies: Routinisation of the Migration Emergency Governance in Lithuania and Poland in 2020–2023

abstracts.content: This paper investigates the governance of emergencies in Lithuania and Poland from 2020 to 2023, focusing on how multiple crises, namely, the COVID-19 pandemic, the humanitarian crisis on the border with Belarus, and the inﬂux of Ukrainians ﬂeeing a full-scale Russian invasion were handled. In response to these events, both countries introduced measures aimed at governing human mobility. In this study, drawing on security practices and discourse research, the authors analyse how the governments proceeded from one emergency to another. The analysis explores the interplay between emergency governance, populism, and technocracy, focusing on the concept of “routinisation” – i.e., how temporary emergency responses become permanent governance strategies. While both countries faced similar challenges, their responses diverged, with Poland’s populist government emphasizing militarised border controls and a narrative of protecting sovereignty, and Lithuania adopting a more technocratic approach, striving to maintain the proper functioning of the state. However, the overall difference between these two countries was more modest than it could be presumed; both states converged in their management of the migration emergencies, increasingly normalising restrictive measures. By comparing legislative and discursive strategies, this paper highlights how emergency governance evolved from improvisation to ﬁxed policies, raising questions about the implications for democratic governance and migration policies.

title: How Do Consumers Inform Themselves About Insurance Products in the Digital Age? Analysing the Results of a Consumer Survey

abstracts.content: Modern technologies, including digitisation processes, are increasingly and permanently changing the insurance market. In this context, the process of using services offered in the insurance sector should be redefined. This chapter draws attention to a critical factor when concluding an insurance contract: obtaining information about insurance products by insurance consumers. The authors present the results of their study conducted on a representative sample of 2136 respondents from Poland. The study analysed the question of what sources of information about the insurance offer to be purchased consumers most frequently use. The study considered the respondents’ characteristics (e.g., age, gender, level of education, or income). Further, the study analysed whether respondents read the content of insurance contract documents and whether they understood these documents. Moreover, the respondents’ experience in using insurance comparison websites was examined. Finally, the study analysed consumers’ attitudes towards digital technologies, as well as their recognition and use. The results suggest that the relevance of digital technologies in insurance has increased, which is reflected, among other factors, in how consumers seek information about insurance products or use online tools to compare offers. Nonetheless, depending on various factors considered in the analysis, the use of consumer opportunities related to digitalisation varies significantly in practice. The study concludes by recommending the continual development of a tailored and predictable legal framework to ensure the protection of digitally vulnerable insurance consumers.

title: Impact of AI technology on economic growth : challenges and recommendations

abstracts.content:
This report examines the transformative potential of Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly generative AI (GenAI), on economic growth, with a specific focus on Poland and the Central and Eastern Europe (CEE) region. AI presents a significant opportunity, potentially boosting Poland’s annual GDP by 5–8% primarily through enhanced productivity across various sectors. However, the report highlights a considerable adoption gap, with Poland lagging behind the EU average
in AI implementation (5.9% vs. 13.5% of firms) and overall digital maturity.
Based on a mixed-methods approach, including surveys of Warsaw Stock Exchange (GPW) listed companies and SME participants in the “Skills of Tomorrow: AI” programme, alongside desk research, the study reveals distinct adoption patterns. Large Polish companies demonstrate
high awareness and management engagement with AI, yet face significant barriers including unclear return on investment, high costs, system integration challenges, skill gaps, and security/ ethical concerns, often resulting in implementation levels lagging behind initial enthusiasm. In contrast, SMEs show promising, albeit often spontaneous and bottom-up, adoption driven by individual “AI pioneers” focusing on automating routine tasks, enhancing creativity, and improving communication.
Key cross-cutting challenges hindering broader AI adoption in Poland include the difficulty in quantifying business benefits, a significant digital skills gap across society, potential security and ethical risks (including shadow AI), and an underdeveloped external support ecosystem (R&D institutions, consultancies, public funding). The report concludes with targeted recommendations
for key stakeholders.

title: International Trade from the Perspective of the Shift of the Geoeconomic Paradigm and Sustainability

abstracts.content: This chapter focuses on explaining the international trade situation from the perspective of the shift of the geoeconomic paradigm and sustainability. International trade today is shocked by the rapid change of the trade tariffs by the USA, China, and The EU which can be treated as the trade war. The globalization idea was to remove the trade barriers to make the global trade more open for the countries especially developing ones. Methodology of this research is based on the documents and data reports analysis with the reference to the most recent World Trade Organization data. The main conclusion from this chapter is that due to the growing tensions and dominance of China in the global trade the international trade is no longer free but is getting more restrictive and protected. Another important aspect is the questionable trade sustainability related to the products which use the critical mineral in their production and values chains. While China’s EVs contribute to the global transition towards cleaner transportation, the sustainability of these vehicles is compromised by carbon-intensive production methods and market practices that disrupt fair competition. Addressing these issues requires a holistic approach that considers the entire lifecycle emissions of EVs and promotes equitable trade practices to ensure that the shift to sustainable transportation is both environmentally effective and economically fair.

title: Applying Large-Scale Distributed Computing to Structural Bioinformatics – Bridging Legacy HPC Clusters with Big Data Technologies using kafka-slurm-agent

abstracts.content: This paper presents the Kafka Slurm Agent (KSA), an open source (Apache 2.0 license) distributed computing and stream processing engine designed to help researchers distribute Python-based computational tasks across multiple Slurm-managed HPC clusters and workstations. Written entirely in Python, this extensible framework utilizes an Apache Kafka broker for asynchronous communication between its components. It is intended for non-expert users and does not require administrative privileges or additional libraries to run on Slurm. The framework’s development was driven by the introduction of the AlphaFold protein structure prediction model, specifically, it was first created to facilitate the detection of knots in protein chains within structures predicted by AlphaFold. KSA has since been applied to several structural bioinformatics research projects, among others, leading to the discovery of new knotted proteins with previously unknown knot types. These knotted structures are now part of the AlphaKnot 2.0 web server and database, where KSA is applied to manage the knot detection process for user-uploaded structures.

title: The Wars and Conflicts in the Global World Shaping the New World Order

abstracts.content: This chapter examines the contemporary landscape of wars and conflicts across the world, with a focus on their root causes, ongoing developments, and potential resolutions. It analyzes the geopolitical tensions in key conflict zones, including the Russia-Ukraine warRussia-Ukraine war, the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, and persistent instability in regions such as Syria, Yemen, and the Horn of Africa. The study also explores the role of major global powers, alliances, and international organizations in shaping these conflicts and their outcomes. The methodology of this research is based on the analysis of official documents, data reports, and recent academic studies. It incorporates assessments from institutions such as the United Nations, NATO, and independent conflict monitoring organizations. The chapter examines military strategies, economic sanctions, cyber warfare, and the use of misinformation in modern conflicts, highlighting the impact of hybrid warfare tactics. One of the main conclusions of this chapter is that while conventional warfare between states persists, as seen in the Russia-Ukraine war, non-state actors, insurgencies, and proxy wars play an increasing role in global instability. The ongoing war in Ukraine demonstrates how geopolitical rivalries and territorial disputes can escalate into full-scale armed conflicts, reshaping global security policies. Meanwhile, the renewed escalation in the Israeli-Palestinian conflict highlights the deep-seated historical and political complexities that hinder resolution efforts. Additionally, long-standing conflicts in the Middle East and Africa continue to be fueled by ethnic tensions, resource competition, and foreign interventions. This chapter underscores the urgent need for diplomatic engagement, economic stability, and coordinated international efforts to prevent further escalations. While conflict remains a persistent global challenge, fostering dialogue, enforcing humanitarian law, and strengthening global governance mechanisms are crucial steps toward sustainable peace.

Indeks konkurencyjności inteligentnych miast jest indeksem złożonym, stanowiącym autorskie i nowatorskie narzędzie analityczne, oparte na analizie 39 zmiennych zgrupowanych w pięć kluczowych wymiarów konkurencyjności inteligentnych miast, tj. wymiar ekonomiczny
i finansowy, komunikację i infrastrukturę zdrowia publicznego, infrastrukturę ICT, instytucje i e-administrację oraz umiejętności, cyfryzację i zaawansowanie rynku. W niniejszym opracowaniu IKIM wykorzystano do analizy obejmującej osiem polskich miast (Warszawę, Kraków,
Gdańsk, Katowice, Poznań, Łódź, Lublin i Rzeszów). Wyniki badania wskazują, że Warszawę i Kraków można sklasyfikować jako miasta najbardziej konkurencyjne, przy czym konkurencyjność Krakowa w latach 2015–2020 stopniowo rosła i tym samym dystans między Krakowem a liderem zestawienia, tj. Warszawą, zmniejszał się. Jednocześnie w latach 2021–2022 to Kraków
został sklasyfikowany na najwyższej pozycji listy rankingowej sporządzonej na podstawie IKIM. Gdańsk, mimo znacznych wahań w ocenie konkurencyjności w analizowanym okresie, zajął trzecie miejsce w 2022 r. Lublin i Rzeszów odznaczały się z kolei najniższym poziomem konkurencyjności, co wskazuje na strukturalne wyzwania związane z rozwojem tych ośrodków jako konkurencyjnych inteligentnych miast w Polsce.

The objective of this study is to model and construct the Smart City Competitiveness Index (SCCI) and apply it as a tool for analyzing competitiveness of selected urban centers in Poland over the period 2015–2022. The SCCI is a composite index, an innovative analytical tool designed to
evaluate competitiveness of smart cities. It utilises 39 variables, encompassing five key dimensions of smart city competitiveness: economic and financial, built environment, ICT infrastructure, institutions/e-government, and skills/digitization/market sophistication. This study applies
SCCI to examine the competitiveness of eight selected Polish urban centers, including Warsaw, Krakow, Gdańsk, Katowice, Poznań, Łódź, Lublin, and Rzeszów, over the period 2015–2022. The results of the study indicate that Warsaw and Krakow were consistently ranked as the most competitive cities, with Krakow’s competitiveness gradually increasing, thus narrowing the gap
with the leader of the ranking, i.e. Warsaw. However, data for 2021–2022 suggest that it wasKrakow that ranked as the top performer. Gdańsk, despite significant fluctuations in competitiveness ratings over 2015–2022, was the third best performer in 2022. Lublin and Rzeszów
exhibited the lowest levels of competitiveness, indicating structural challenges in developing these centers as competitive smart cities in Poland.

title: Effectiveness of healthcare systems in Central and Eastern European countries

abstracts.content:
The study aims to assess the effectiveness of healthcare systems in Poland and Central and Eastern European countries within the context of the entire EU, using the value-based healthcare (VBHC) framework. The analysis incorporates data on healthcare financing, system organisation, accessibility, lifestyle factors (e.g. tobacco use, alcohol consumption), and health outcomes
(such as healthy life expectancy and avoidable mortality). Statistical methods, k-means clustering, and data envelopment analysis (DEA) were applied.
Findings reveal substantial differences in healthcare system performance across the EU. Poland belongs to a group of countries with low healthcare system efficiency, characterised by relatively
low public health expenditure, limited access to services, and unfavourable public health behaviours. High avoidable mortality and low healthy life expectancy (HALE) rates raise particular concerns. In contrast, Czechia demonstrates significantly better outcomes, underscoring the importance of coherent, long-term health policies in keeping society healthy. Key policy recommendations include increasing public health investment, improving access to medical services, strengthening prevention programmes, and implementing public campaigns
promoting healthier lifestyles. The report highlights the need for systemic transformation of the Polish healthcare system towards a more value-based and patient-centred approach. The results offer critical insights for policymakers and stakeholders seeking to enhance health system efficiency in the region.

title: Interventions for cognitive frailty: developing a Delphi consensus with multidisciplinary and multisectoral experts

abstracts.content: Introduction: The conjunction of physical frailty and cognitive impairment without dementia is described as Cognitive Frailty (CF). Indications that CF is potentially reversible have led to proposals that risk factors, symptoms or mechanisms of CF would be appropriate targets for interventions for prevention, delay or reversal. However, no study has brought experts together across sectors to determine targets, content or mode of interventions, and most resources on interventions are from the perspective of academic or clinical researchers only. This international Delphi consensus study brings together experts from academic and clinical research, lay people with lived experience of CF, informal carers, and professional care practitioners/clinicians. Methods: Three rounds of Delphi study were held to discern which factors and statements were agreed upon by the whole sample and which generated different views in those with differing expertise. A scoping review and Round 1 (29 participants) were used to gather initial statements. In Round 2, 58 people responded to statements and open text items, comprising 7 lab-based researchers, 27 researchers working with people, 14 people with lived experience or informal family carers, and 10 professional carers/clinicians. Percent agreement and qualitative responses were analyzed to provide a final set of statements which were checked by 38 respondents in Round 3. Results: Analysis of Round 2 quantitative data provided 74 statements on which there was at least 70% agreement and qualitative data produced a further 24 statements. These were combined to provide 90 statements for Round 3. There was Consensus for 89 of the statements. A few differences between the groups were observed at both stages. Discussion and conclusion: The consensus for statements associated with CF interventions provides a useful first step in defining health promotion activities and interventions. Given the prevalence and potential disability caused by CF in older populations, the consensus statements represent expert opinion that is inter-sectoral and will inform public health policies to support implementation of evidence-based prevention and intervention plans. This study is an important step toward changing current approaches, by including all stakeholders from the outset. Outcomes can be used to feed into co-creation of interventions for cognitive frailty.

title: Perspektywy rozwoju krajów Europy Środkowo-Wschodniej w latach 2025-2035 : zmiany instytucjonalne i wzrost gospodarczy w patchworkowym modelu kapitalizmu

abstracts.content:
W opracowaniu podejmujemy próbę określenia perspektyw rozwoju krajów członkowskich Unii Europejskiej (UE) z Europy Środkowo-Wschodniej (EŚW-11) w latach 2025–2035. W tym celu sporządzamy wielowariantową prognozę ścieżek ich wzrostu gospodarczego i realnej
konwergencji dochodowej, wpisaną w szerszy kontekst instytucjonalny, tj. najważniejszych cech powstałego w tych krajach modelu kapitalizmu patchworkowego. Przesłanką wyjściową naszego podejścia jest założenie, iż konstrukcja i sposób działania instytucji silnie determinują
wyniki gospodarcze, w tym tempo wzrostu gospodarczego i realnej konwergencji. Opracowanie składa się z dwóch części. Część I, retrospektywna, zawiera opis genezy i charakterystykę
najważniejszych cech kapitalizmu patchworkowego oraz analizę porównawczą i ocenę przebiegu trajektorii wzrostu krajów EŚW-11 w latach 2004–2024 na tle całej UE, ze szczególnym
uwzględnieniem czterech modeli kapitalizmu zachodnioeuropejskiego. Rozwinięciem analizy porównawczej jest dekompozycja stóp wzrostu PKB na główne składowe, tj. tempo zmian
zasobów pracy i kapitału oraz dynamikę łącznej produktywności czynników wytwórczych (total
factor productivity, TFP), a także ocena długookresowych determinant wzrostu gospodarczego.
Z kolei w części II, prospektywnej, zostały nakreślone możliwe kierunki ewolucji kapitalizmu patchworkowego w latach 2025–2035; ta część pracy zawiera także autorską prognozę przyszłych ścieżek wzrostu i konwergencji dochodowej gospodarek krajów EŚW-11 do średniego poziomu krajów „starej” Unii (UE-15) w tym samym okresie. W prognozie zostały uwzględnione trzy scenariusze: bazowy, pozytywny i ostrzegawczy. Większość z nich zakłada, że proces
realnej konwergencji będzie kontynuowany, choć w coraz wolniejszym tempie, co tłumaczymy negatywnym oddziaływaniem syndromu krótkowzroczności instytucjonalnej cechującego
model kapitalizmu patchworkowego. W scenariuszu ostrzegawczym kraje EŚW-11, z nielicznymi
wyjątkami (w tym Polska), doświadczą jednak odwrócenia się dotychczasowych tendencji rozwojowych i wejdą na ścieżkę dywergencji dochodowej. Opracowanie zamyka podsumowanie,
w którym zostały sformułowane najważniejsze wnioski i rekomendacje dla polityki gospodarczej i strategii rozwoju, w tym zwłaszcza zalecenia, które mogą zmniejszyć prawdopodobieństwo materializacji scenariusza ostrzegawczego.

This paper seeks to outline the development prospects of the Central and Eastern European (CEE-11) EU member states in 2025–2035. To this end, we make a multivariate forecast of the
paths of their economic growth and real income convergence, embedded in the broader institutional context, i.e. the key features of the model of patchwork capitalism that has emerged in these countries. The starting premise of our approach is that the design and operation of
institutions strongly determine economic performance, including the rate of economic growth and real convergence. The study consists of two parts. The first, retrospective part contains
a discussion of the origins and the most salient features of patchwork capitalism, as well as a comparative analysis and assessment of the growth trajectory of the CEE-11 countries in the
period 2004–2024 against the background of the entire EU, with a particular focus on the four models of Western European capitalism. The comparative analysis is developed by decomposng GDP growth rates into their main components, i.e. the rate of change of labour and capital
stocks and the dynamics of total factor productivity (TFP), as well as assessing the long-term determinants of economic growth. The second, prospective part outlines the possible lines of
the evolution of patchwork capitalism in 2025–2035; this part of the paper also includes the authors’ forecast of future growth paths and income convergence of the CEE-11 economies to the
average level of the countries of the “old” Union (EU-15) over the same period. The forecast is presented in three scenarios: baseline, positive and the cautionary one. In most of these scenarios, the process of real convergence will continue, albeit at a decelerating pace, which is due
to the adverse impact of the institutional shortsightedness syndrome inherent to the model of patchwork capitalism. In the cautionary scenario, however, the CEE-11 countries, with few exceptions (including Poland), would experience a reversal of hitherto development trends and
enter a path of income divergence. The study closes with the most important conclusions and recommendations for economic policy makers, including in particular recommendations that would diminish the probability of the cautionary scenario materialising

title: Killing Two Birds with One Stone: Systematic Review on Elevating Bleisure Travel Through Big Data Insights

abstracts.content: The burgeoning trend of bleisure travel combines business and personal travel to boost productivity and satisfaction. A comprehensive review investigates how big data analytics improves bleisure travelers’ experiences. This analysis synthesized the literature to see if data-driven initiatives might boost social consumer participation and happiness in this travel sector. This study examined the systematic use of big data analytics to understand leisure travel. Leisure travelers’ recurring tendencies, choices, and behaviors will be examined to determine how data-driven insights might better target marketing and customized services. A thorough literature search was conducted in PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar. In 2010–2024, this investigation was undertaken. The inclusion criteria were big data analytics in leisure travel, social consumer interaction, and personalized marketing. Qualitative analysis and critical appraisal skills programme (CASP) protocols assessed methodological study quality. The findings show that big data analytics can transform leisure travel. Understanding travelers’ wants and preferences improves marketing and service. An understanding like this does not help the travel sector. Understanding traveler behavior helps acquire and use data from more sources using advanced analytics techniques, improving customer engagement and happiness. Big data analytics can enhance leisure travel by offering tailored and attractive travel offerings. It advances the literature on data-driven methods to understand and address leisure travelers’ demands. In the dynamic travel market, we must continually adapt, develop new analytical methods, and investigate new data sources to better our personalization efforts.
